summary: BTQ Technologies Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, attaching a news release dated August 11, 2026. The release announces a shareholder webinar scheduled for August 14, 2026, to discuss Q2 2026 financial results and provide a general corporate update, following the release of financial statements. No special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report for an earnings call notice. There are no deal terms, board actions, or strategic corporate events referenced. The appropriate classification is none, as no special situation exists.
